title: Kayaks & Paddleboards
seo_title: Kayaks & Paddleboards | Quest Watersports, Ottawa IL
seo_description: Shop Hobie Mirage Drive kayaks, Old Town and inflatable kayaks, fishing kayaks and paddleboards at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL. Rentals and demo rides too.
body_html:
At Quest Watersports we live, work and play on the water, and we are here to help you do the same. From pedal-powered Hobie Mirage Drive kayaks to fishing kayaks, inflatables and stand-up paddleboards, we bring the latest in water-based experiences to the heart of Starved Rock Country.

Shop kayaks

  • Hobie kayaks: pedal-powered Mirage Drive kayaks, fishing machines and tandems
  • Hobie iTrek inflatable kayaks
  • Old Town kayaks, including Sportsman fishing models
  • Advanced Elements inflatable kayaks
  • Used and demo kayaks
  • Kayak parts and accessories

Find the right fit

  • Hobie kayak dealer and model guide
  • Kayak fishing and fishing-ready setups
  • Stand-up paddleboarding
  • Pre-owned and demo kayaks
  • Kayak rigging and free demo rides
  • Hobie First Cast guided fishing outings

Try before you buy

Book a free demo ride at Heritage Harbor, or rent a kayak or paddleboard for a day on the water. See demo rides and kayak and paddleboard rentals.

Financing, trade-ins and consignment

  • Finance your kayak
  • Sell or trade your kayak

Talk to us

Call 815.433.2200 or email hobie@questwatersports.com. Showroom: 1851 N 2871st Road, Ottawa, IL 61350.
